title: Yield Wallet
tagline: A wallet that passively earns yield on stablecoins using state channels
description:
This project uses cross chain balances from Avail Nexus and Yellow streaming to allow for instant settlement.
Any deposited stablecoins will earn yield from vaults and can also be instantly withdrawn at any time.
PYusd is the main stablecoin used for yield generation. Two seperate liquidity sources are managed, one is the hot wallet with state channels and another is actuallly used for yield farming.
how_its_made: This project uses erc7824 state channels for instant settlement facilitated through the Yellow sdk. Avail Nexus also allows for cross chain balances and the usage of stablecoins from multiple chains in passive yield generation. The backend works similar to centralized exchange, a hot wallet allows for instant settlement with state channels and a seperate liquidity pool actually does the yield farming which is tracked and matched with deposits from the hot wallet.
